preconditions.description: The number of points n is an integer between 2 and 2000 inclusive.
The threshold k is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
Both n and k are integers.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n points.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(x) <= 10**9 and abs(y) <= 10**9 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All coordinates are within the range [-10^9, 10^9].
The computed value of tot (number of inner loop iterations) exceeds k, causing TLE.

postconditions.expression: output_is_no_solution or (len(points) == n and tot_computed > k)
postconditions.description: If no valid configuration exists, output 'no solution'; otherwise, output n valid points satisfying the TLE condition.
